name: memory
summary: One private repo holds what your agents learn and what you save, and every box reads it.
day: A trap one agent hits on your hub is a note the next agent reads on a node, minutes later. You mention last week's planning in a prompt, and the agent gets a link to the note about it before it starts.
cost: You need a small private GitHub repo. It syncs every five minutes, and saving a link runs one short agent. Dream, when you turn it on, spends your AI plan's usage each night.
risk: Agents write notes about you and your work into the repo, read it on every prompt, and saving a link writes a note from other people's text into it. Keep the repo private.

workflows.name: Shared memory
workflows.sentence: Agents on every machine read and write one private memory repo, which syncs every five minutes.

workflows.name: Context library
workflows.sentence: Once you set context-library.repo to your private notes repo, a prompt about one of its topics gets links to its documents, hedge context searches and saves notes, and every machine pulls the repo every five minutes.

workflows.name: Dream
workflows.sentence: Each night, the hub reads the day's agent sessions from every machine and opens one draft pull request that adds to, condenses, and prunes your shared memory.
workflows.risk: Every run sends your agent sessions to an analyst model and spends your AI plan's usage, so it starts off. Your session text stays on the hub for 14 days.
